title: Composer 2 Released
description: Cursor released Composer 2 with advanced programming performance capabilities. Additionally added over 30 new partner plugins (Atlassian, Datadog, GitLab, Glean, Hugging Face, monday.com, PlanetScale), Automations for building resident agents, JetBrains IDE support via ACP, and various editor improvements including Bugbot Autofix and AI Code Review.

community_feedback.quote: Composer 2 is just Kimi K2.5 with RL - rushes through everything without any apparent reasoning or planning, it just tries to execute as quickly
Composer 2 is usable - working well with medium level styling issues, complex handling of some APIs
86% cost reduction compared to Composer 1.5 at $0.50/M input pricing

title: Bug Fixes and Performance Improvements
description: Various bug fixes and performance improvements across Cascade, MCP, and stability components with Mac x64 build fixes.

title: Copilot Coding Agent Validation Tools Configuration
description: Users can now configure Copilot coding agent's validation tools, providing more control over how the agent validates and verifies code changes during development workflows.

title: GPT-5.3-Codex Long-Term Support
description: GPT-5.3-Codex is now available in long-term support for GitHub Copilot, providing stable access to OpenAI's coding model for enterprise and professional development environments.

title: Persistent Agent Threads for Pro and Max Plans
description: Claude released a persistent agent thread feature for Pro and Max plans to manage tasks in Cowork from mobile and desktop, enabling enhanced cross-platform task management capabilities.

community_feedback.quote: Claude Code is being used for ticket triage - it reads tickets, digs into the codebase, and leaves comments with suggestions

title: GPT-5.4 Mini Model Support
description: Windsurf added support for GPT-5.4 Mini, available at 1x credits with promotional pricing. Includes bug fixes for Apple M5 support.

community_feedback.quote: I was horrified after the new GPT-5.4 system destroyed my credits in just a few queries with no warning
GPT 5.4 works well for me in Windsurf

title: Copilot Coding Agent Semantic Code Search
description: Copilot coding agent now works faster with semantic code search capabilities, improving the agent's ability to find and understand relevant code context across repositories.

title: GPT-5.4 Mini General Availability
description: GPT-5.4 mini is now generally available for GitHub Copilot users, bringing OpenAI's latest compact model with improved efficiency and performance for coding tasks.

title: Copilot CLI Activity in Usage Metrics
description: Copilot usage metrics now includes organization-level GitHub Copilot CLI activity, providing better visibility into command-line tool usage across teams.

title: Skip Approval for Copilot Actions Workflows
description: Users can now optionally skip approval requirements for Copilot coding agent Actions workflows, enabling faster automated development cycles for trusted workflows.

title: Updates for Students
description: GitHub released new updates to GitHub Copilot specifically for students, enhancing accessibility and features for educational use.

title: Auto Model Selection in JetBrains IDEs
description: Copilot auto model selection is now generally available in JetBrains IDEs, automatically choosing the best model for different coding tasks.

title: Code Review from GitHub CLI
description: Users can now request Copilot code review directly from GitHub CLI, integrating AI-powered code review into command-line workflows.

title: Major Agentic Capabilities for JetBrains IDEs
description: Major agentic capabilities improvements in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains IDEs, enhancing AI-powered development features across IntelliJ platform.

title: Explore Repositories on the Web
description: Users can now explore a repository using Copilot directly on the web, enabling AI-assisted code exploration without installing IDE extensions.

title: Cascade and MCP Improvements
description: Fixed dangling Diff Zones for Jupyter Notebooks, improved Jupyter performance on WSL, enhanced Cascade UI rendering, improved notifications for model price changes, and added support for SKILL.md files.
